column2: Securing AI Systems: A Guide to Known Attacks and Impacts (arXiv paper referenced on J-AISI output page)
column6: Literature survey/taxonomy by J-AISI researchers (Kiribuchi, Zenitani, Semitsu) of 11 known attack types mapped to CIA-triad impacts; synthesis of others' published work, no original evidence-backed finding (fails protocol s1.0 criterion 1)

column2: AI検証ノート：AIが見つける脆弱性に違い！ / AI Experiment Notes: AI Models Differ in the Vulnerabilities They Find!
column6: Qualifying methodology finding with measured results: three (anonymised) AI models given the same vulnerability-assessment task found non-matching issue sets (15 vs 13 vs 13 issues, differing severity mixes; one model's output partly blocked by safety controls); published 2026-07-08, inside cutoff; no matching report in canonical v9 dataset — candidate miss for extraction

column2: 「AIシステムに対する既知の攻撃と影響」に関する更新 / Updates on \Known Attacks and Their Impacts on AI Systems\""
column6: Announcement of second edition of the 'Known Attacks' reference document updated from the conference paper (arXiv 2506.23296); the underlying work is a literature survey with no qualifying original findings, and this page adds none

column6: Announcement of AI-IRS incident-response conceptual framework/approach book; guidance only, no measured results or observed behaviours
